title: Fork the two independent subtrees, join once, then combine
caption: tree_sum on [5, 3, 8, 1, 4, null, 9]: the left subtree sums to 8, the right to 17, the total is 30.

messages.label: submit left subtree
messages.note: Fork: hand the left subtree to a worker and don't wait.

messages.label: submit right subtree
messages.note: Fork again. The two subtrees share no writes, so they can run at the same time.
Join: main blocks on both futures; this one finishes first.
Combine only after both results are in: the single synchronisation point.
